caption: The top cup of a tower of stacked plastic cups on a carpet is swiped sideways, and the top of the tower falls.

sa.check: A tower of stacked plastic cups stands on a carpet.
The top cup is swiped sideways.
The top of the tower falls.
Only the top cup is swiped.
The swipe comes first and the fall follows.

pc.expect: The struck cup flies off in the direction of the swipe, and the cups below wobble and some fall.
pc.fail: The struck cup flies against the swipe; or the whole tower drops straight down as one piece; or the bottom cups fall while the top stays.

pc.expect: Cups that leave the tower fall to the carpet and stay there.
pc.fail: A cup hangs in the air; or rises; or lands and bounces back onto the tower.

pc.expect: Cups move only after being struck or losing their support.
pc.fail: Cups fall before the swipe; or a landed cup slides with nothing touching it; or a lower cup jumps off untouched while the tower above it stays.

pc.expect: The plastic cups are light and stiff: they bounce and roll on the carpet without breaking.
pc.fail: A cup shatters; or squashes flat and stays flat; or the carpet ripples like water.

pc.expect: The cups keep their number and pass through nothing.
pc.fail: Cups vanish or multiply; or a cup passes through another; or a cup turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cups' colours, the carpet and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: A cup changes colour or size; or the carpet changes pattern between frames; or the room rearranges.
